title: Arkret MLS Governance Proof Bundle
description: Bounded chunk of a complete-materialization proof bundle used by a light client to verify an MLS full-profile governance binding against an accepted Seal. The bundle deliberately does not copy the candidate governance_binding: the verifier owns the RFC 9420 current/pending leaf set, rederives security_frontier_digest from that leaf set plus this materialization, and compares the result with the transcript-authenticated binding. The fixed-size manifest commits every ordered chunk through chunks_root; the verifier accepts only after fetching all chunks, checking contiguous collection ranges, and recomputing the accepted Seal roots. proof_request_digest binds the acquisition identity, bundle_digest addresses the complete logical bundle, and each chunk_digest addresses one bounded transport chunk. accepted_seal_id alone is not a Bundle cache key.

proof_request_digest.description: sha256(UTF-8('arkret-mls-governance-proof-request-v1\n') || RFC 8785 canonical JSON bytes of the proof identity object containing realm_id, effective_scope, mls_group_id, previous_epoch, next_epoch, binding_profile, reducer_profile and trusted_anchor_seal_id). Transport fields chunk_index and expected_bundle_digest are excluded. The verifier MUST recompute it before using or caching any chunk.

bundle_digest.description: Content address of the complete logical bundle: sha256(UTF-8('arkret-mls-governance-proof-bundle-v1\n') || RFC 8785 canonical JSON bytes of all top-level response members except bundle_digest and chunk). chunk_manifest.chunks_root transitively commits every chunk. A verifier MUST recompute this digest for every response.

materialization_profile.description: The only v1 profile. Across every committed chunk, covered_event_digests is the entire recursive covered_set of accepted_seal_id and control_state is the entire sorted set of non-bottom joined control cells committed by its state_root.

trusted_anchor_seal_id.description: MUST equal proof_request.trusted_anchor_seal_id bit-for-bit. This is a Seal id the verifier already trusts through authenticated Realm bootstrap or prior successful verification. Presence in this bundle never makes an anchor trusted.

accepted_seal_id.description: Id of the accepted Seal whose control_event_set_root and state_root authenticate this bundle. It MUST identify the final Seal assembled from the seal_path chunks.

trusted_anchor_seal_id.description: Seal id already trusted by this verifier. The service MUST construct seal_path from this exact anchor (or its direct successor) and MUST NOT silently substitute a newer, older, or service-selected anchor. A bootstrap client uses the Realm genesis/compaction Seal only after validating it through its authenticated Realm bootstrap, join, snapshot, or equivalent trust package.

chunk_index.description: Zero-based global chunk index. The first request MUST use 0. Later requests use an index below chunk_manifest.chunk_count and include expected_bundle_digest.

expected_bundle_digest.description: Required when chunk_index is greater than 0 and forbidden for chunk_index 0. It pins later reads to the exact manifest returned by the initial request.

proof_request.description: Authenticated account-client query input. The service materializes accepted control state from one Seal view so the client can rederive the registry-closed security_frontier_digest; callers MUST NOT supply roots or frontier members. chunk_index and expected_bundle_digest select transport chunks and are excluded from proof_request_digest. The caller MUST name one locally trusted anchor. If the service cannot prove a path from that exact anchor to the target accepted Seal, it returns mls_governance_anchor_unreachable and MUST NOT suggest or substitute an untrusted anchor. Genesis requests MUST use previous_epoch=0 and next_epoch=0; commit requests MUST use next_epoch=previous_epoch+1.

chunks_root.description: Merkle root over chunk_digest raw bytes in chunk_index order, using SHA-256(0x00 || chunk_digest_raw) leaves and SHA-256(0x01 || left || right) internal nodes.

total_item_bytes.description: Sum of the UTF-8 byte lengths of RFC 8785 canonical JSON for every individual item across all four collections. Array delimiters and repeated response metadata are excluded. A verifier recomputes this incrementally and MUST NOT allocate from the declaration.

chunk_manifest.description: Fixed-size commitment to the complete chunk sequence. Chunk order is all seal_path chunks, then covered_event_digests, control_state and frontier_events; within a collection start_index is contiguous and items retain canonical collection order. Empty collections emit no chunk.

chunk_proof.description: RFC 6962-style inclusion path for chunk_digest at chunk_index under chunk_manifest.chunks_root. At most 10 siblings are needed for the 1024-chunk limit.

proof_chunk.description: One bounded collection slice. chunk_digest = sha256(UTF-8('arkret-mls-governance-proof-chunk-v1\n') || RFC 8785 canonical JSON bytes of {chunk_index, collection, start_index, items}); chunk_proof authenticates that digest under chunk_manifest.chunks_root.
